source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.

Interior partition wall thickness treated as zero per the geometry contract; centerlines were derived from measured pixel gaps and labeled dimension chains (1F: 250mm labeled corridor walls; ~120mm inferred office dividers making the 15000mm chain sum exactly; 2F: clean round-number centerlines at 3.0/5.0m corridor bounds and 3.75/7.5/11.25m office dividers, matching measured pixel gaps within a few percent).

Interior corridor-to-office/meeting-room door widths and exact positions (F1:D_N1-3, D_S1-3; F2:D_R1-2, D_O1-4) are approximated from visible arc/frame symbols near the bay-dividing partitions; exact widths are not individually dimensioned in the drawing. Their head heights (2.1m above each floor) are an unobserved standard-door assumption.

East-facade window heights (F1:W_E1, F2:EW1) and the corridor's West-facade 2F window (F2:WW1) are assumed to match the North/South window family for their floor (1F sill1.0/head2.6m from claim_0001; 2F sill4.0/head5.8m from claim_0002) by symmetry of the East_view.png/West_view.png dimension pattern (3400/1200/3400), but were not independently re-derived from a dedicated East/West dimension_chain claim in this run.

South wall 2F window positions (F2:SW1a/b, SW2a/b) are taken directly from South_view.png's own upper-zone dimension chain (1950/3600/3900/3600/1950=15000mm), which places two 3600mm-wide window bands independent of the 3.75m office grid; each band was split at the office/office partition it crosses so every opening hosts on one wall segment. The correspondence between these two continuous window bands and the four individual offices behind them is a simplification, not an independently confirmed per-office window count.

Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping or inferred partition was applied beyond the stated calibration and centerline choices.

unresolved: 1F/2F interior door widths and exact positions at every corridor junction remain approximate (visible arc symbols only, not individually dimensioned); their 2.1m head height is an unobserved assumption, not linked to any elevation.

East-facade window heights (F1:W_E1, F2:EW1) and 2F corridor West window (F2:WW1) remain unlinked to a dedicated East/West elevation height claim in this run; they carry the North/South family value by symmetry assumption only.

The exact physical correspondence between the two large South-facade 2F window bands and the four individual south offices is unresolved; it is plausible the window mullions do not align with the interior office partitions exactly as modelled.

Calibration (pixel-to-metre anchors) for both floor plans and all four elevations is caller-supplied from measured outer wall faces and dimension-chain pixel positions; it was cross-checked against multiple independent dimension chains (footprint totals, window/door families) with consistent results within about 0.3%, but was not independently re-verified by a second reviewer.
Furniture-implied room uses (office/lobby/meeting) are inferred from plan furniture symbols, not from any text label in the drawing.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound direct original returns from view_image or paired elevation views are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.next_action: Use-basis records saved; unresolved inferences remain explicit.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

decision.reason: Crop confirms dimension chain labels 800/1800/1000/400/1600/1000 matching declared 1F window family.

claims.reason: North_view.png vertical dimension chain (right side, x~255) reads top-to-bottom 800/1800/1000/400/1600/1000 from roof (z=6.6m) to ground (z=0), summing to the overall 6600mm height (3600mm 2F + 3000mm 1F). The 1F window family sits in the lower 3000mm zone: head at 428px (z=2.6m, i.e. 400mm below the 3.0m floor line) and sill at 520px (z=1.0m, 1600mm window height). These five 1F windows on the North and South walls share this same dimension family (identical 2400mm-wide window symbols in the plan).

decision.reason: Same crop confirms 2F window family head/sill segments.

claims.reason: Same North_view.png vertical dimension chain as the 1F window claim. The 2F (upper zone) window family sits in the upper 3600mm zone: head at 244px (z=5.8m, 800mm below the 6.6m roof line) and sill at 347px (z=4.0m, 1800mm window height). These six 2F windows (2 meeting-room windows plus 4 split office-window segments) share this identical dimension family.

decision.reason: Crop shows the door/small-window dimension chain 900/600/1500 with the small window symbol aligned to the 600 segment.

claims.reason: South_view.png door-adjacent vertical dimension chain (900/600/1500 from the 3.0m floor division down to ground) places this small window's head at 448px (z=2.1m) and sill at 482px (z=1.5m); pixel span of the drawn window symbol (448-482) matches this chain segment exactly.

South_view.png shows the entrance door symbol spanning from the 3.0m floor-division chain down through 900mm (head at z=2.1m) to ground (z=0m); the door leaf's own internal glazing bar sits at the 600/1500 split within that span, confirming head=2.1m, sill(ground)=0.

West_view.png double-leaf door drawn from ground (z=0, pixel561) up to head at pixel440; using the same 6.6m roof (pixel181) to 0m ground (pixel561) calibration, head z = 6.6-(440-181)*6.6/380 = 2.1m.

current_claim_state.note: Current numerical/context consistency only; neither retained nor confirmed means drawing truth.

height_coverage.note: Coverage means a current adopted z binding, not proof that the drawing or BIM is correct. Inference and declared values do not count as located-image height evidence.
